subject: Proposal: Surge Protection Add-on + Month-end Surge Ledger
messages:
From: Rebecca Shaw <rebecca.shaw@cloudware.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudware Procurement <procurement@cloudware.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity question — short-term headroom

Hi Dev,

Thanks for the quick chat this morning. We have an expected marketing spike the week of Sep 29 that will likely exceed our committed monthly quota by ~30-45% for a 72-hour window.

We want to avoid surprise invoices and procurement headaches. Two asks:
- Can Redwood offer a short-term "surge protection" add-on that caps overrun exposure and provides a predictable per-surge fee?
- If we do hit the cap, can billing be recorded to a month-end "surge ledger" that we reconcile with our finance team rather than immediate overage billing?

If possible, Rebecca (Procurement) and I would like a written proposal + any sample ledger format by EOD Monday so we can fast-track approvals.

Thanks — Rebecca
Rebecca Shaw
Head of Platform Ops, Cloudware Inc
rebecca.shaw@cloudware.com

P.S. Procurement is open to a short-term AMEX charge if the terms look good.

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rebecca Shaw <rebecca.shaw@cloudware.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Surge Protection Add-on + Month-end Surge Ledger

Rebecca — great to connect. Appreciate the clear asks. Summary below and attached a short terms draft plus a sample ledger workbook.

Summary proposal (short version):
- Surge Protection Add-on: a 72-hour headroom pool equal to 50% of your monthly commit, activated by Cloudware via the Console or API.
- Surge fee: flat $6,000 per 72-hour surge activation (covers the first 50% above commit). Additional overrun beyond the surge pool billed at an overrun rate of $0.012 per 1k tokens.
- Surge Ledger: Usage that consumed the surge pool will be recorded to a month-end ledger (Surge_Ledger_Sample.xlsx). Finance will receive a consolidated invoice line item; we defer detailed reconciliation for up to 30 days after invoice generation.
- Limits: Max 2 activations per calendar month; additional activations require pre-approval and may incur a 10% surcharge.

Attachments: Surge_Protection_Terms_v1.pdf (terms + termination), Surge_Ledger_Sample.xlsx (example ledger).

Next steps I propose:
1) Rebecca/Procurement confirm they can accept the deferred ledger reconciliation path.
2) If yes, I’ll loop in billing to create a one-line MID for accounting and send a DocuSign link for the add-on amendment.
3) We can put a short canary guard in place (read-only alerts + a pre-activation notification call) so Cloudware has final approval before a surge goes live.

Laura/Marissa — flagging for discount/approval. Cloudware is a mid-market customer; they asked about cost containment and prefer predictable fixed fees over variable overage. Any flexibility on the flat surge fee or activation count?

— Dev
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Surge Protection Add-on + Month-end Surge Ledger

Dev — quick internal note before we send a final to Cloudware.

Context: Cloudware is close to migrating a second product next quarter; keeping them happy for predictable pricing matters. Recommendation:
- Reduce flat surge fee to $4,500 for the remainder of 2025 (one-time promotional concession) if they sign the add-on within 7 days.
- Increase activations to 3/month for the promotional period.
- Keep the overrun per-token rate at $0.012 per 1k tokens but add a cap: total post-surge overrun exposure not to exceed $12k per surge activation.

Marissa — any concerns from finance on the $12k cap and deferred ledger reconciliation? If acceptable, Dev can offer Cloudware a 30-day pilot amendment with promotional pricing.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Sales — West

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rebecca Shaw <rebecca.shaw@cloudware.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Cloudware Procurement <procurement@cloudware.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Surge Protection Add-on (promo) + Ledger + DocuSign

Rebecca — thanks for the patience. Per internal alignment we can offer a short promotional Surge Protection Add-on to cover your Sep 29 marketing spike:

Promotional terms (one-time, sign within 7 days):
- Surge window: 72 hours activation; promotional flat fee: $4,500 per activation.
- Activations allowed: up to 3 in a calendar month for the promo period (through 2025-12-31).
- Overrun rate beyond surge pool: $0.012 per 1k tokens. Post-surge overrun exposure capped at $12,000 per activation.
- Billing: Usage consumed from the surge pool will be recorded in a month-end ledger and invoiced as a single line item. We will hold reconciliation items for up to 30 days to allow Cloudware finance to validate.
- Pre-activation: We will send an automatic pre-activation email and offer a 15-minute confirmation call before any surge goes live.

Attachments: Surge_Protection_Terms_v1.pdf, Surge_Ledger_Sample.xlsx.

If this looks good I’ve opened a DocuSign packet here: https://redwood.app/docusign/CW-2025-0918-A — signing will attach the add-on to your existing contract and enable the promotional pricing immediately.

If procurement prefers a quick phone sign-off, we can accept an emailed PO plus the acceptance email from Rebecca to trigger activation.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk through the ledger and the pre-activation workflow.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198
Attachments: Surge_Protection_Terms_v1.pdf (20KB stub), Surge_Ledger_Sample.xlsx (12KB stub)
